name: Apiary Studio — Honeycomb Navigation
summary: Site navigation concept where a honeycomb of hexagonal cells replaces the menu bar; move across the comb and open a cell.
description: A self-contained HTML study of navigation built as a honeycomb. The page presents 'Apiary Studio' with a 'Design · Research · Slow Craft' tagline and asks the visitor to move across the comb and choose a cell to open it (Cell 01 leads to Work). One of the Fable 5.1 100 HTML Files studies.
